context.transcript:
Tanya, when did we start selling these reusable grocery bags?
Has it been two weeks?
I want to see our customers using them to carry their groceries home from our store, but nobody's buying them.
Well, they are rather simple.
They're in plain colors and only have the store's name on them.
Hmm.
What can we do to make them more interesting?
Well, the store's name is on one side of the bag, what if we asked some local artists to design images to put on the other side?
I like that.
I'll get an ad in the local newspaper about this, asking any interested artists to contact us.
context.transcript_translation:
Tanya，我们什么时候开始销售这些可重复使用的杂货袋？
已经两周了吗？
我想看到我们的顾客用它们把杂货从我们的店里带回家，但没有人买。
嗯，它们相当简单。
它们是纯色的，上面只印着商店的名字。
嗯。
我们能做些什么让它们更有趣呢？
嗯，商店的名字印在一面袋子上，如果我们请一些当地艺术家在另一面设计图案怎么样？
我喜欢这个主意。
我会要在当地报纸上刊登一则广告，询问任何有兴趣的艺术家联系我们。
